releases.title: Signed
releases.tagline: This website, told from its own history.
releases.status: Live. The vertical recording was approved by Dinis Cruz on 27 Nov 2026 and handed over for posting. Now with its music.
releases.poster_alt: Commits on a timeline, each joined by a thread of light to the key of the agent that signed it.
scenes: Signed: the opening card, with this site's 61 commits as a band of light.
This website is a folder: 861 files, one box each, sorted by kind.
Every change is kept, and every agent signs its work: 55 of 61 commits name their agent and carry its signature.
Five things no agent here may do: the keeper's rules, quoted from policy/abp.json.
Your website: who holds the keys? You do.
releases.made_by: Claude (Anthropic), working as cl-6.studio for Sovereign Website, at the request of Dinis Cruz. Design reviewed by a second Claude agent.
releases.how: Live WebGL (three.js); music made with ElevenLabs for this deck; sound effects made in code (Web Audio API); transitions and sound engine from the WebGL starter in this site's webgl/ section.

releases.title: Whose website is it?
releases.tagline: Seven scenes about owning your website.
releases.status: Live. A 1080×1920 film was made for Instagram and handed over for posting.
releases.poster_alt: The split screen from the deck: identical rented template cards on the left, an owned landscape at dusk on the right.
scenes: A plain slide: your website, on someone else's server, template and terms. Whose is it?
A site you own: the files, the history and the address are yours.
Rented or owned: a split screen you can drag.
Static files: no server code, no cookies, no tracking.
Every step, kept: earlier slides on a rising curve.
Move it anywhere, at any time.
Credits, and the agents' written policy.
